oIoU_definition: global pooled oIoU: 100 * sum_j |pred_j ∩ GT_j| / sum_j |pred_j ∪ GT_j| over all val records (GLOD-RIS: 'oIoU measures global overlap'); the per-sample mean IoU is the rows/mIoU field

shipped.rule: learned selector head (DECLARED TRAINED): HistGradientBoostingClassifier (max_depth 3, 250 iterations, lr 0.08, seed 0) over eight of-ours per-proposal terms (full-sentence region-text score on the cached masked-region features; box-overlap IoU; center-in-box; log mask/box area ratio; log mask area; within-record ranks of the region-text score and of box overlap; containment-parent flag); fitted on the RefCOCO-family held-out TRAIN tune refs only (1,137 / 1,120 / 765 records); official val and test are evaluation-only; the head uses no released HybridGL scores -- the restriction stage is rebuilt from our own terms (exp/out_final/head_rebuild.json, exp/out_final/component_provenance.json)

training_free_reference.rule: released-score top-15 restriction (rank01(sc) + 0.4906*rank01(gem)) + box-fill pick -- the training-free realization, reproduced bit-exactly as the exp159 reference arm

shipped.arm_selection: head fitted on the held-out TRAIN tune refs; official val applied once per frozen configuration (exp159_head_rebuild.py)

head_promotion_note: 2026-10-15: the shipped head is the learned selector (declared trained). The previous shipped head (released-score restriction + box, training-free) is reproduced bit-exactly and retained as the training-free reference in rows/oIoU/shipped.training_free_reference.
